unfair_advantage: Scalable user acquisition through existing platform and brand recognition, with a large and engaged user base.
milestone_1: Achieve 1 million paid users, with a 20% month-over-month growth rate.
milestone_2: Expand into new markets and geographies, with a 30% increase in revenue from international sources.
milestone_3: Develop and launch new features and products, with a 25% increase in average revenue per user (ARPU).
kill_risk: Dependence on a single large investor and potential loss of funding.
thesis_summary: Grindr has a scalable business model and a large user base, making it a potential long-term winner in the dating and social media space.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to achieve 1 million paid users within the next 2 years.
ten_k_highlights: We have a scalable business model with a large and engaged user base, which we believe will drive long-term growth and profitability.
Our revenue has been increasing at a rate of 125.6% over the past 5 years, and we expect this trend to continue.
We have a strong balance sheet with $23.81 million in cash and a positive cash flow from operations, which will allow us to invest in our business and drive growth.
valuation_note: FCF yield 5.3%, PEG 0.5, EV/EBITDA 20 — fairly valued for its growth.
